title: Mining Frames: Association Rule Mining as an Unsupervised Framework for News Framing Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.31874v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computational framing analysis is dominated by supervised classifiers that require large annotated corpora and predefined frame taxonomies, limiting their use for non-English languages, novel events, and low-resource settings. This paper presents Association Rule Mining (ARM) as an unsupervised, annotation-free framework for news framing detection. Each document or sentence is treated as a transaction of lexical items, and high-lift co-occurrence rules are read as candidate framing signals (Gamson and Modigliani's condensing symbols), confirmed in context by journalist-researchers. The primary validation is Framing Gaza: 25,512 English-language articles from 16 US, UK, French, and German outlets covering the first year of the Gaza war (October 2023 to October 2024), analyzed with Apriori (mlxtend), platform-weighted support, POS-filtered n-grams, and lift-based scoring. translated_title: 挖掘框架：将关联规则挖掘作为新闻框架检测的无监督框架
translated_abstract: 计算框架分析目前主要由有监督分类器主导，这些分类器需要大规模标注语料库和预定义的框架分类体系，限制了其在非英语语言、新事件和低资源环境中的应用。本文提出将关联规则挖掘作为一种无监督、无需标注的新闻框架检测框架。每篇文档或句子被视为词汇项组成的事务，高提升度的共现规则被解读为候选框架信号（即Gamson和Modigliani所说的“浓缩符号”），并由记者-研究者在上下文中加以确认。主要验证案例为“加沙框架”研究：来自16家美国、英国、法国和德国媒体的25,512篇英文文章，涵盖加沙战争的第一年（2023年10月至2024年10月），采用Apriori算法（mlxtend）、平台加权支持度、词性过滤的n-grams以及基于提升度的评分进行分析。ARM能够在没有预定义分类体系的情况下归纳性地涌现出可解释的模式……
tldr: 该论文提出将关联规则挖掘（ARM）作为无监督、无需标注的新闻框架检测新框架，通过对加沙战争首年25,512篇新闻文章的分析验证了其无需预定义分类体系即可归纳发现可解释框架模式的能力。
